castVote(uint256[2],uint256[2][2],uint25.details: It checks four things, in order, and stops at the first one that fails:        1. Does this election exist and is it still active?        2. Is the election's deadline still in the future?        3. Has this vote's commitment actually been registered (see `registerCommitment`)?        4. Has this vote's nullifier already been used (i.e. is this a repeat vote)?

params.commitment: — The previously registered sealed vote commitment this proof corresponds to.
params.nullifier: — The one-time-use value proving this specific vote hasn't been cast before.
params.proofA: — The first component of the zero-knowledge proof.
params.proofB: — The second component of the zero-knowledge proof.
params.proofC: — The third component of the zero-knowledge proof.
params.proposalId: — The election this vote is being cast in.
params.voteOption: — Which option (e.g. which candidate, as a number) this vote is for.

createProposal(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Can only be called by `admin` (enforced by the `onlyAdmin` modifier above).

params.deadline: — The Unix timestamp after which no more votes will be accepted.
params.numOptions: — How many choices this election has (e.g. 4 for a 4-candidate race).
params.proposalId: — A unique identifier chosen by the admin for this election.

getResults(uint256).details: Reads directly from the `tally` mapping and reshapes it into a simple list, one      entry per option, in option order (index 0 first, then 1, 2, and so on). No      individual vote is ever exposed by this or any other function.

params.proposalId: — The election to fetch results for.

returns.results: — An array where `results[i]` is the number of votes option `i` has received.

registerCommitment(uint256,uint256).details: The `commitment` is computed by the voter's own browser, before this call is      made, as a one-way cryptographic function of their chosen vote and a secret      only they know. Because it's one-way, this contract can record the commitment      on-chain without being able to work backwards to learn the vote it hides.

params.commitment: — The voter's sealed vote commitment, computed client-side.

castVote(uint256[2],uint256[2][2],uint25.notice: Casts a vote by submitting cryptographic proof that it is valid, and — if         the proof checks out — permanently records it in the running tally.

createProposal(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Creates a new election that voters can subsequently register and vote in.

getResults(uint256).notice: Returns the current vote count for every option in a given election, so         anyone can see the outcome without needing any special permission.

registerCommitment(uint256,uint256).notice: Registers a voter as eligible to vote in an election, without revealing         which option they intend to vote for.
